mean_M_diagnostics.method: For each cell, sum(M) ~ Poisson(trials*m); exact doubled smaller tail and 0.05/640 threshold; PRNG floating point model as recorded in run protocol. This is a diagnostic, not proof of RNG quality.

gain_interpretation.valid_higher_output_definition: full_lower > count_lower AND full_joint == false; this means a valid tighter output under empirical truth, not necessarily rescue of a failed count result.
gain_interpretation.rescued_definition: full_joint == false AND count_joint == true; higher-output restriction separately reported.

high_precision_failure_confirmation.method: Recompute each full-failure path with Arb exact_output from original fingerprint, independent of stored vectorized score intervals; geometry/weights are same certified-arithmetic implementation.

limits: Boolean truth/event audit is independent exact integer/rational recomputation. Failure score replay uses the same Arb formula implementation at higher precision, not a second symbolic estimator implementation.
Only one entire cell per data source had RNG replay; all 640 cells had fingerprint, hash, block and truth/event checks.
